services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Art, history, and the natural world of the Pacific Northwest, across two buildings. Two iconic Bellingham venues. One unforgettable event. Whether you're planning a wedding, a corporate celebration, a musical performance, or something we haven't even thought of yet - the Whatcom Museum has a space that's anything but ordinary. A Bellingham landmark with Victorian cupolas, a clock tower, and a grand staircase that makes every arrival feel like an entrance. Old City Hall brings warmth, character, and genuine history to any occasion. services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: Art, history, and the natural world of the Pacific Northwest, across two buildings. Let your CREATIVITY shine at the Whatcom Museum this summer! Explore science, art, and engineering concepts in imaginative and exciting ways. Your kiddos can enjoy a week stomping with the dinosaurs, learning about backyard birds and the natural forces that shape our planet, experimenting with earth elements, or creating art out of natural dyes and fibers. NEW THIS YEAR: In 2026, we’re debuting teen camps with hands-on workshops exploring our current art exhibitions.
